Native task lifecycle fixtures (aienos-mv#429): three pipeline stage units and their realization receipts.
Label for everything here: QEMU (aarch64 virt), TEST signer, not physical.

Sources:    tgen.osc, txform.osc, tsink.osc (this directory; stage ABI v1, core/task.h, UNVERIFIED own contract).
Compiler:   oscc built from aien-dev/omega a8ffd2b912c84197d08f963b05f9c7d8b30a3f8a (main on 2026-10-18).
            IR and code are REAL oscc output, one function per unit, entry record from oscc's .entries
            (fn 0, nregs 4, ret_kind 5, reg_kind 11 5 12 5: bytes, u64, cells, u64).
Containers: the spec's own generator helpers (aien-protocols-mv specs/osc-unit-artifact/tools/make-vectors.sh at
            fb5fca98e6676bb104888c73268e0f9a81e9c63e), TEST signer (throwaway key test1), no caps,
            max_stack_bytes 16384, cpu_ticks 1000.
Receipts:   omega checker2 (src/checker2 unchanged since 265ce82a, the commit pinned in osc_receipt/PROVENANCE.txt, so the
            same checker_id), TEST key, target aienos-ck-aarch64-el0, epoch 10, expiry 1000; each verified VALID by
            checker2 under the kernel's qualification policy (floor 10, epoch 20) by make-task-units.sh.
Reproduce:  make-task-units.sh --check <aien-protocols specs/osc-unit-artifact> <omega checkout> rebuilds all six files in
            a temporary directory and requires them byte-identical (run on 2026-10-18: all six "same").
